tonight.headline: McLaurin sat Friday — a rest day, says Keim — so Saturday's report still decides
body: Bad news first: Terry McLaurin did not practise Friday after a limited Thursday. Washington call it a veteran rest day, not a hamstring setback (John Keim, 16 Oct), and the final designation comes Saturday. He plays Monday night; every bench option locks on Sunday. Alvin Kamara, the only rostered cover, was limited all week with his back and is questionable.

Everything else is set: the lineup is the projection lineup, 127.0, against Bok-aneers' 112.5, ESPN 57%. One cheap improvement: Tyler Allgeier is a free agent and Arizona's starter with Jeremiyah Love ruled out; adding him for the idle Vikings defence gives McLaurin a healthier cover that locks three hours later than Kamara.

case.label: Why it matters
case.body: If McLaurin is ruled out or doubtful on Saturday and nothing is moved before Sunday afternoon, the slot scores zero.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A plain questionable on Saturday: then McLaurin starts and the fallback is not used.

doFirst.title: Add Tyler Allgeier, drop the Vikings D/ST
doFirst.subtitle: A free agent who starts Sunday, for a defence on bye — better cover for McLaurin than Kamara.

case.label: The player
case.body: Arizona ruled out Jeremiyah Love (ankle) on Friday and LaFleur will re-evaluate him next week (Arizona Sports 16 Oct). Allgeier leads the backfield, 'most of Love's early-down work', 15-18 touches projected, with Bam Knight rotating (DK Network 16 Oct). He is a free agent: no priority, no wait.

case.label: The drop
case.body: The Vikings D/ST: on bye, a second defence behind the Patriots, and the slot has not changed hands this week.

case.label: Why it helps
case.body: If Washington rule McLaurin out on Saturday, Allgeier 12.4 replaces him instead of Kamara 10.1, who was limited all week with his back and took 3 carries behind Kendre Miller in Week 5 (archive). His game starts Sun 14:05, not 11:00, so the decision window is longer. If McLaurin plays, Allgeier sits: Tuten 13.1 against 12.4 is a coin flip and the projection keeps Tuten.

case.label: The risk
case.body: Allgeier's target share over two games is 4.8% (DK Network) — a carries-only back in full PPR. Week 5 he had 3 carries for 3.6 (archive). This is depth, not a starter.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: McLaurin is ruled out, Allgeier starts in his place and scores less than Kamara (archive) — or a rival had no interest and the spot was better kept for Tuesday's Week 7 bye fixes.

case.label: The news
case.body: McLaurin limited Thursday, did not practise Friday. Washington call Friday a veteran rest day, 'not a setback' (John Keim via RotoWire/CBS, 16 Oct 12:58 ET). Final report Saturday.

case.label: The clock
case.body: McLaurin kicks off Monday 18:15 CDMX. Kamara locks Sunday 11:00, Allgeier Sunday 14:05. The lineup tool's Monday 16:45 inactive check comes after both, so the move rests on Saturday's designation.

case.label: The fallback
case.body: Kamara: questionable, limited Wednesday to Friday with the back (NewOrleansSaints.com 16 Oct). Allgeier if added: healthy and starting. Check either is active 90 minutes before his kickoff.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: McLaurin is listed doubtful, the cover starts, and McLaurin plays Monday and outscores him (archive) — or he is only questionable, stays in, and is inactive at Monday 16:45.

case.label: What it changes

case.label: What would change it
